scope: All 22 modern quarters for model arithmetic and existing release/revenue/path evidence; targeted filing/call review of all six original large misses and calls from three ordinary comparison quarters
comparisons: Keep original >=5-cent error threshold; all 16 ordinary quarters in quantitative comparison; three call controls explicitly selected for extreme market moves, not representative random controls
model_math: Reproduce archived four-feature production predictions exactly, retain coefficient signs, centered contributions and 0.5 shrinkage; no new model or tuned correction
counterfactual: Removing shrinkage is explanatory sensitivity only across all22, not proposed promotion or fresh validation
disclosure: Do not classify pending audits as no disclosure; newly discovered passages go to a separate pending evidence queue
causality: Distinguish confirmed model arithmetic, issuer-reported mechanisms, analyst hypotheses and unquantified economic residual; no complete causal cents attribution without evidence
accounting: Do not assign supply/RIN effects or LIFO reserve balances to retail margins; do not back out acquisition costs from already-reported margins
